feed.deadline_reason: Update now. Older versions can miss signing a day's TDH attestation when this computer's own TDH result is ready late, and then that day earns nothing.

releases.notes:
- A validator now signs the day's TDH attestation even when its own result is ready only after the network applied that day, so the day earns for its account. Before, it never signed such a day and said nothing.
- 0.27.1 doesn't go back to 0.27.0.

Nothing to do if auto-update is on.
